_comment: DEMO DATA. notices = bell panel per user (tone drives icon+color, target = menu item id). notifiedAt = when the notice was issued, ALWAYS rendered with the label «Notificado:» — business dates (deadline, trip, deposit) live inside text. FOLIO RULE (client V2): in prose the request number is always introduced as «folio 000nn» («Nueva solicitud folio 00045…»). deadlines = header chip. counters = pending pills per menu item.
